highlights.title: Kasus · Case endings
highlights.detail: A one-screen table of der, den and dem with the rese, nese, mrmn code, the six questions that tell you which case a phrase is in, and a quick drill for the endings.

highlights.title: Kasus-Farben · Case colors
highlights.detail: Each case now has its own color and icon wherever it's taught, rules and explanations put key words in bold and every article in its gender color, and the quick lessons for Akkusativ, Dativ and Genitiv show the endings table with that case lit up.

highlights.title: Die vier Fälle · The four cases
highlights.detail: Grammar is now one path through Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ and Genitiv, each with its rule and a quick round.

highlights.title: Geschichten · Case stories
highlights.detail: Seven short stories to mark the cases in and then fill in the missing articles, with gender hints if you want them: Nominativ and Akkusativ at A1, Dativ at A2, and Genitiv and Alle Fälle at B1.

highlights.title: Verlauf · Your rounds
highlights.detail: Every grammar round you play is kept, day by day, with your score per case. Open a story or quick round to see each answer again, with why.

highlights.title: Mehr dazu · Also for this case
highlights.detail: Each case links to the preposition cards that take it, with their 3D scenes, and Nominativ to der · die · das.

highlights.title: Gezielt üben · Practice that fits
highlights.detail: A weak case on Today or in Coach's Notes opens a story to fill in or a quick round, Artikel opens a der/die/das round, and a class entry tagged with a case, Artikel or prepositions gets its own practice row.

highlights.title: Richtig! · Clearer right and wrong
highlights.detail: Each answer shows at once whether you got it, with the right article in its gender color and a dot per question, and the quick round puts the sentence up large with the buttons at the bottom.

highlights.title: Your tutor is loading · Download progress on Home
highlights.detail: Home shows a live bar for the download, so you can carry on working while your teacher lands.

highlights.title: Was ist neu · What's New
highlights.detail: Release notes now live in the app: once after each update, and any time from Settings ▸ About.

highlights.title: Bewerbung · Job prep
highlights.detail: Save a job posting from the browser, study its language, and rehearse the interview for that role.

highlights.title: Type instead of talk
highlights.detail: Conversations accept typed turns, with a quick German/English keyboard switch.

highlights.title: Dein Weg · Your journey
highlights.detail: A timeline of your progress, with a „Weißt du es noch?“ check on words you learned a while ago.

highlights.title: Placement answers you can revisit
highlights.detail: The placement check keeps your answers, to review question by question or hand to the coach.

highlights.title: Abzeichen · Badges
highlights.detail: Milestones for streaks, words learned, perfect rounds and first stories.

highlights.title: Earned, not estimated
highlights.detail: The Lernpyramide now separates what you've proven from what a declared level only suggests.

highlights.title: Gespräch · Picking a chat back up
highlights.detail: If a chat is interrupted, reopening it offers to fetch the reply you were waiting for instead of leaving you stuck.

highlights.title: Wortschatz · One word box for A1–B1
highlights.detail: The three Goethe lists share one box, so a word learned at A1 stays learned at A2. Pick your levels and word types and press Start.

highlights.title: Der Karteikasten · Your word box
highlights.detail: A bar for each compartment shows how your words move from new to known.

highlights.title: Neue Wörter · New words in daily portions
highlights.detail: Set how many new Goethe words a day, and ask for ten more when you are on a roll.

highlights.title: der · die · das? · Gender first
highlights.detail: Nouns hide their article until you flip, so every card is a gender check. Turn it off in Settings ▸ Cards.

highlights.title: Noch einmal · Missed cards come back
highlights.detail: A card you mark Didn't know returns a few cards later in the same session.

highlights.title: Wörter durchsuchen · Every word's status
highlights.detail: Browse all Goethe words as new, due, tricky, or known, and tap one for its history.

highlights.title: Pluralformen · Plural and Perfekt forms
highlights.detail: Hundreds of Goethe nouns and verbs now show their plural or Perfekt forms on the card.

highlights.title: Bilder · Picture layout
highlights.detail: Story pictures are shown whole instead of cropped, and you can pick how they sit in the text.

highlights.title: Speicher · Memory
highlights.detail: See what is using memory now, and a log of any crashes, under Settings ▸ Speicher.

highlights.title: Stabiler · More stable
highlights.detail: Runs more reliably on iPads and phones with less memory: pictures, tutors and the drawing model no longer compete.

highlights.title: Tastatur · German keyboard
highlights.detail: A new keyboard for Mail, Messages, and anywhere you write: type in English, tap Auf Deutsch, and it becomes natural German.

highlights.title: Korrigieren · Fix your German
highlights.detail: Select what you wrote and tap Korrigieren: it fixes the grammar and keeps your own words.

highlights.title: Sie oder du
highlights.detail: Choose whether the keyboard writes formally or informally, so an email to your landlord doesn't read like a text to a friend.

highlights.title: Umlaute ohne Umweg · Umlauts made easy
highlights.detail: Hold a, o, u, or s for ä, ö, ü, and ß, with spell-check in German or English.

highlights.title: Nothing leaves your phone
highlights.detail: It runs on Apple Intelligence on your device and never asks for Full Access.

highlights.title: Deutschkurs · Class notes
highlights.detail: Log what each class covered, keep the handouts, track homework, and turn the new words into flashcards for that course.

highlights.title: Karten aus dem Dokument · Flashcards from a document
highlights.detail: Turn a teacher's word list into a deck in one go, or highlight phrases in any PDF, photo, or text to make cards.

highlights.title: Vokabeln im Text · Vocab in the story
highlights.detail: Read a class story with its vocab list: listed words are underlined, and a tap shows the teacher's English.

highlights.title: Nebeneinander lesen · Read side by side
highlights.detail: Read a translated handout in German, in English, or both at once, scrolling together sentence by sentence.

highlights.title: Deck teilen · Share a deck
highlights.detail: Swipe a deck in the Library and send it by AirDrop, Messages, or Files. Your review progress goes with it.

highlights.title: Mischen · Shuffle
highlights.detail: A Shuffle switch on the flashcard setup screen deals the cards in a fresh order every time you start.

highlights.title: Tutors for smaller phones
highlights.detail: Additional models that fit lower-end devices.

highlights.title: Vorstellungsgespräch · Job interview chats
highlights.detail: A clearer flow for interview practice.

highlights.title: Präpositionen in 3D · Preposition game
highlights.detail: A new grammar game where every spatial word is acted out in 3D.

highlights.title: Einstufung · Placement quiz
highlights.detail: A new entrance quiz and proficiency selector, A1 to C1.

highlights.title: Lernpyramide · Learner pyramid
highlights.detail: Track your progress layer by layer.

highlights.title: Easier story translation
highlights.detail: Unknown words in short stories are simpler to look up.

highlights.title: Farbige Artikel · der, die, das in colour
highlights.detail: Articles are colour-coded in conversation views.

highlights.title: German Tutor, a model fine-tuned for this app
highlights.detail: Gemma 4 E4B, trained on a German tutoring dataset built for Die Kartei and running entirely on device. It writes every story and backs the coaching, cards and corrections.

highlights.title: Open model, open data
highlights.detail: The model and its training data are public on Hugging Face.

highlights.title: Story Mode · Lesen
highlights.detail: Read a short story at your level, then answer comprehension questions in the format of the Goethe and ÖSD reading exams.

highlights.title: Illustrated stories, two voices
highlights.detail: Stories can be illustrated on device, and separate male and female voices make dialogue sound like two people.

highlights.title: A coach that watches where you struggle
highlights.detail: Weak spots from cards, games and chats come back as targeted drills, and a streak calendar on Home shows each day's practice.

highlights.title: Two games
highlights.detail: Vocab Matching with your own decks, and Der/Die/Das from the on-device dictionary.

highlights.title: Bulk jobs
highlights.detail: Queue the heavy work, illustrated decks and story images, and let it run in one pass.

highlights.title: Smarter article checking
highlights.detail: Every card is checked against the bundled Wiktionary. Compounds take the gender of their last part, reliable endings cover most of the rest, and nouns with two valid articles are no longer flagged.

highlights.title: Reminders on your terms
highlights.detail: Choose the cadence or turn them off, all inside the app.

highlights.title: Rebuilt navigation and haptics
highlights.detail: New navigation now that there is more to reach, plus haptics on flashcard and multiple-choice answers with settings to tune them.

highlights.title: KI-Sprachchat · AI Voice Chat
highlights.detail: Practice speaking German out loud in 20+ everyday scenarios or on a grammar focus, and get corrected as you go.

highlights.title: Hints, translations, replies read aloud
highlights.detail: Tap any word for its meaning, and every reply can be read aloud.

highlights.title: Sag es auf Deutsch · Say it in German
highlights.detail: Work out what you want to say from English, then get coached through saying it.

highlights.title: Coaching report after every chat
highlights.detail: Each conversation ends with a report and can become a flashcard deck.

highlights.title: Save phrases you hear in the wild
highlights.detail: Double-tap or highlight any phrase in a chat to save it. The AI weaves active ones into later chats, and saved phrases can become decks.

highlights.title: Cards from your own material
highlights.detail: Scan PDFs, scan photos, or paste a webpage to build cards and conversations.

highlights.title: The app takes on your model's look
highlights.detail: Colours follow whichever AI model you pick, conversations included.

highlights.title: Also in this update
highlights.detail: A Conversation settings tab, step-by-step instructions for Apple's higher-quality voices, smarter model loading, and the first Akkusativ and Dativ cards in the Goethe decks.

highlights.title: Die Kartei
highlights.detail: AI flashcards for German: generate a deck on any topic, study it, and keep the words that stick.
